text: Write a function merge_intervals(intervals) that merges overlapping or touching closed intervals given as [start, end] pairs and returns them sorted.
Write a function from_roman(text) that returns the integer value of a Roman numeral and raises ValueError for a string that is not a canonical numeral between 1 and 3999.
Write functions encode(text) and decode(pairs) for run-length encoding: encode returns a list of (character, count) tuples and decode reverses it.

Write a function build_order(deps) where deps maps a task name to a list of names it depends on. Return a list in which every task follows its dependencies, taking the alphabetically smallest ready task first, and raise ValueError on a cycle.
Write a class LRU(capacity) with get(key), returning None when absent, and put(key, value), evicting the least recently used entry when over capacity. Both get and put count as use.
test_list: c = LRU(2); c.put(1, 'a'); c.put(2, 'b'); assert c.get(1) == 'a'; c.put(3, 'c'); assert c.get(2) is None and c.get(1) == 'a' and c.get(3) == 'c'
c = LRU(1); c.put('k', 1); c.put('k', 2); assert c.get('k') == 2
c = LRU(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.put(1, 10); c.put(3, 3); assert c.get(2) is None and c.get(1) == 10

text: Write a function seconds(text) that parses durations such as '1h30m', '45s', '2d' or '1m5s' (units d, h, m, s, each at most once, in that order) into seconds, raising ValueError otherwise.

Write a function first_unbalanced(text) that returns the index of the first bracket among ()[]{} that makes the text unbalanced (an unmatched closer, or else the earliest unclosed opener), or -1 when balanced.
Write a function spiral(matrix) that returns the elements of a rectangular list of lists in clockwise spiral order starting at the top left.
